title: Aging, sales, purchases and expiring stock reports
summary: Find overdue invoices and bills, and see sales, purchases and expiring items.

steps.text: Open {rep} from the sidebar; the operational reports sit alongside the financial statements.
Click {ar} to see which customer invoices are overdue, grouped into aging buckets.
Click {ap} for the same view of vendor bills.
Click {sales} for sales by customer. Purchases and expiring stock have their own reports in the same list.
